android-play.comment: Live since 2026-10 — listing is public (uses appId)

ios-appstore.comment: Set appleId when App Store Connect listing is live

macos-appstore.comment: Mac App Store — often same appleId as iOS

windows-store.comment: Microsoft Store listing. url takes precedence; productId is the store detail id (used only as a fallback).

linux-flathub.comment: Flathub app id defaults to appId when live:true
